page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9a.xlarge is a compute-optimized instance hosted on the KVM hypervisor. It is powered by the x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T25 processor operating at a clock speed of 2.7 GHz. The system provides 4 dedicated vCPUs paired with 8.0 GB of memory, yielding a compute-focused ratio of 2.0 GB of RAM per vCPU.

The instance does not include integrated local disk storage, requiring persistence to be provisioned via attached network block storage volumes. Networking performance is established with a baseline bandwidth of 4 Gbps. Accelerated graphics processors are omitted, featuring a zero GPU count, and no complimentary public IPv4 addresses are assigned by default.

From an efficiency standpoint, the dedicated vCPU allocation provides consistent compute power for CPU-bound tasks without overpaying for unused memory footprints. The primary resource tradeoff is the conservative 8.0 GB memory capacity and reliance on remote storage, which bounds the footprint of memory-intensive datasets and requires deliberate IO configuration.

Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9a.xlarge is suitable for batch processing pipelines, web servers handling high request volumes, continuous integration and build workers, and front-end application layers that prioritize raw CPU cycles over high memory capacity.
description: Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9a.xlarge is a compute-optimized virtual server running on the KVM hypervisor. Driven by an x86_64 AMD EPYC 9T25 processor at 2.7 GHz, the instance delivers 4 dedicated vCPUs and 8.0 GB of system memory, establishing a 1:2 vCPU-to-memory ratio. The configuration excludes local storage disks and dedicated GPUs, relying entirely on network-attached storage for persistent data requirements. Network connectivity includes a baseline throughput of 4 Gbps, while public IPv4 addresses are not included natively. The strict 2.0 GB RAM per vCPU resource allocation optimizes costs for CPU-dominated workloads by avoiding excess memory expenditures, though it restricts memory-heavy architectures. Alibaba Cloud ecs.c9a.xlarge is designed for distributed microservices, application compiling, batch computing, and medium-scale web serving environments.
